title: Anthropic updates its usage policy to ban "sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior" toward Claude, ending chats as the primary enforcement mechanism (Hayden Field/The Verge)
summary: Hayden Field / The Verge: Anthropic updates its usage policy to ban “sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior” toward Claude, ending chats as the primary enforcement mechanism — The usage policy update also adds new rules addressing propaganda campaigns, surveillance, and weapon development.
